a: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for users sensitive to animation.
forced-colors mode adapts to high-contrast OS settings.
orphans/widows control leftover lines at page breaks.
column-count and column-width create multi-column text layouts.
CSS shapes can wrap text around custom contours.
filter applies visual effects like blur and brightness.
backdrop-filter blurs content behind an element.
mix-blend-mode controls how an element blends with backdrop.
isolation creates a stacking context affecting blends.
contain-intrinsic-size provides sizes when content is skipped.
